old: Returns 100 orders per page by default. Use next_cursor to continue.
new: Returns 20 orders per page by default. Use next_cursor to continue.
risk: Clients may silently process fewer records per request.

old: Events are returned in ascending creation-time order.
new: Event order is unspecified and may change between requests.
risk: Clients that rely on stable ordering may display or process events incorrectly.

old: Requests with the same Idempotency-Key are safe to retry for 24 hours.
new: Idempotency-Key values are retained on a best-effort basis.
risk: Automatic retries may create duplicate payments.

old: A 404 response means the profile does not exist.
new: A 404 response may mean the profile is private or does not exist.
risk: Clients can no longer distinguish absence from authorization policy.

old: All timestamps are returned in UTC.
new: Timestamps are returned in the account's configured local time zone.
risk: Existing timestamp parsing and comparison logic may shift values.

old: Any authenticated account member can list invoices.
new: Only account administrators can list invoices.
risk: Previously authorized callers may start receiving authorization failures.

old: When no recommendations exist, the endpoint returns an empty items array.
new: When no recommendations exist, the endpoint may omit the items field.
risk: Clients expecting an iterable array may fail on a missing value.

old: The rate limit resets 60 seconds after the first request in the window.
new: Rate-limit reset time is determined dynamically by service load.
risk: Fixed retry schedules may repeatedly retry before capacity is available.

old: The amount field is expressed in the currency's minor unit, such as cents.
new: The amount field is expressed in the currency's major unit, such as dollars.
risk: Consumers may display or transfer values at the wrong magnitude.

new: This operation will be removed after 2026-12-31.
risk: The migration window is shortened by one year.
